data.body: **[P2] Preserve a later detached flush when canceling an older barrier.** If the queue contains an older barrier, a record, and a later invocation's detached flush, this loop deletes the later marker and replaces the older barrier before the record. Once unblocked, the worker flushes first, exports the later buffered record, then exits without flushing it. Coalesce at the rightmost marker (or remove the older barrier while retaining the later marker), and add a regression where the newer timeout is canceled before the older queued barrier.
